title: Compositional Periodic Spline Approximation for Circular Density Data in Bayes Spaces
summary: This paper proposes a novel framework for the approximation and analysis of circular density data using compositional periodic splines within Bayes spaces with the Hilbert space structure. By applying the centered log-ratio transformation, densities are represented in a subspace of the standard $L^2$ space of real-valued functions, which enables the use of functional data analysis tools while preserving the relative nature of distributions and their periodic structure.
